paymentIntegrity.blockersTitle: Orders with something missing in the payment
paymentIntegrity.blockersHelper: Check the payments for these orders to continue.
paymentIntegrity.blockerReasonFallback: The payment for order {{orderNumber}} needs checking.
paymentIntegrity.blockerFixFallback: Tell the manager. If the problem persists, contact support.
paymentIntegrity.blockerReasonFallbackWithoutNumber: The payment for this order needs checking.
paymentIntegrity.recordFailureCurrency: The payment was not recorded. Ask the manager to check the store's country.
paymentIntegrity.recordFailureStale: The payment was not recorded. Press "Refresh report".
paymentIntegrity.recordFailureStaleCheckout: The payment was not recorded. Press "Checkout" again.
paymentIntegrity.multipleOrdersSummary: {{count}} orders need a payment check. Start with order {{orderNumber}}. {{reason}}

reasonCodes.missing_cash_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} is missing its recorded cash payment.
reasonCodes.missing_card_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} is missing its recorded card payment.
reasonCodes.missing_local_payment_row: Order {{orderNumber}} says paid, but this till cannot find its payment.
reasonCodes.partial_cash_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} still has unpaid cash remaining.
reasonCodes.partial_card_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} still has unpaid card remaining.
reasonCodes.split_payment_incomplete: Order {{orderNumber}} still has an incomplete split payment.
reasonCodes.unsupported_payment_method: Order {{orderNumber}} uses a payment method that must be collected manually.
reasonCodes.no_persisted_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} was closed without its payment being written down.
reasonCodes.duplicate_payment: The same transaction is recorded more than once on {{orderNumber}}: {{settledAmount}} against an order of {{totalAmount}}.
reasonCodes.overpaid_order: Payments on {{orderNumber}} exceed the order by {{overpaidAmount}}: {{netSettledAmount}} recorded against an order of {{ceilingAmount}}.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_missing: The platform pays for order {{orderNumber}}. The payment of {{totalAmount}} has not been recorded yet.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch: The payment recorded for {{orderNumber}} does not match who collected the money.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__platform_h: The platform pays for order {{orderNumber}}, but the till shows a cash or card payment of {{drawerAmount}}.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__store_coll: {{orderNumber}} is a store order, but {{platformSettledAmount}} was recorded as a payment from the platform.
Our own driver delivered order {{orderNumber}}, but {{platformSettledAmount}} was recorded as a payment from the platform.

fixCodes.missing_cash_payment: Record or confirm the missing cash payment.
fixCodes.missing_card_payment: Record or confirm the missing card payment.
fixCodes.missing_local_payment_row: If the customer has already paid and you see the button, press it to record the payment.
fixCodes.partial_cash_payment: Record the remaining cash payment to continue.
fixCodes.partial_card_payment: Record the remaining card payment to continue.
fixCodes.split_payment_incomplete: Complete all split-payment portions before continuing.
fixCodes.unsupported_payment_method: Review the order and collect the payment manually.
fixCodes.no_persisted_payment: If the customer has already paid and you see the button, press it to record the payment.
fixCodes.duplicate_payment: Correct the payment that was recorded a second time.
fixCodes.overpaid_order: Ask the manager to correct the extra payment.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_missing: Tell the manager. If the problem persists, contact support.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch: Ask the manager to correct the payment that was entered by mistake.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__platform_h: Correct the cash or card payment that was entered by mistake.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__store_coll: Correct the platform payment that was entered by mistake. Record the cash or card payment the store actually received.
Correct the platform payment that was entered by mistake. Record the cash or card payment the driver actually brought back.

blockerReasons.parent_payment_not_synced: Waiting for the parent payment to sync first.
blockerReasons.parent_payment_missing_canonical_remote_: Waiting for the parent payment to receive its remote payment id.
blockerReasons.ambiguous_canonical_remote_payment: Multiple repaired payments match this adjustment. Manual review is required.
